info.description: Noah wallet API. Bearer authentication uses a JWT obtained from /v0/auth/login. Registered-user requirements are stated per operation; email verification is optional. Unsigned 64-bit values use int64 for native Int64/Long clients: practical amounts, sizes, counts and Unix timestamps are below 2^63. This is an interoperability assumption, not a new server validation rule; Rust u64 can represent larger values. JSON extractor and IP rate-limit rejections are plain text, while application errors use ApiErrorResponse.
